title: In Our Own Eyes We Seemed Like Grasshoppers

request.style: English, solemn male solo, organ, cello, timpani, deep choir, somber and reflective, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve men went out from the camp
From the tribe of Issachar Igal came
To scout the land from Zin to Rehob
They cut a branch in the Valley of Eshcol

[Verse]
Forty days they walked the ground
And saw the cities fortified and strong
The descendants of Anak lived there
We seemed like grasshoppers in their sight

[Chorus]
The people who live there are strong
The cities are fortified and very large
We cannot attack those people
They are stronger than we are

[Verse]
The whole congregation broke out in cry
And wept through that long and heavy night
Why bring us to this land to die
Let us choose a leader and go back

[Chorus]
The people who live there are strong
The cities are fortified and very large
We cannot attack those people
They are stronger than we are

[Bridge]
Spreading a bad report on the land
They made the congregation grumble and cry
Before the Lord a plague fell down
Only Joshua and Caleb remained

[Outro]
Only Joshua and Caleb remained
